Release notes/v0.13.6/Nov 21, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.13.6.

> Windows: the installer is still building and will be added to this release shortly. The Mac app is ready now. Cadence Drive shows every computer that's on it, including ones that have only downloaded so far.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 Fixed

  • See all your computers on your drive. Settings → Drive used to list only computers that had written a file, so a Mac that joined and downloaded everything didn't appear. Each computer now tells the drive it's there when it connects (a tiny sealed entry the relay can't read, never put in your folder), and the list counts every one of them.
